{{Quote|I'm Kardeer, her Ladyship's gardener.|Kardeer|<ref name="SWG:K" />}}
'''Kardeer''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Garden/Legends|gardener]] who lived on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], he worked for [[Lady/Legends|Lady]] [[Valarian/Legends|Valarian]], the leader of the [[Valarian Syndicate|Valarian criminal syndicate]], in the ''[[Lucky Despot]]'' [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]]. Kardeer was extremely dedicated to his work and profoundly admiring of his boss. Nevertheless, he often got intoxicated by pesticides.<ref name="SWG:K" />

==Behind the scenes==
Kardeer was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:K" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>
